preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is a positive integer.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(N, int) and N >= 1 for N in N_list)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is a positive integer.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(S, str) and len(S) == 2 * N and all(c in '01' for c in S) for N, S in zip(N_list, S_list))
preconditions.description: For each test case, S is a binary string of length 2*N.
The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all((line == '-1') or (len(line.split()) == N and all(idx in range(1, 2*N+1) for idx in map(int, line.split())) and sorted(map(int, line.split())) == list(map(int, line.split()))) for line, N in zip(output_lines, N_list))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either '-1' or a space-separated list of N distinct indices in increasing order, where each index is between 1 and 2*N inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all((line == '-1' and not exists_valid_partition(S, N)) or (line != '-1' and is_valid_partition_output(line, S, N)) for line, S, N in zip(output_lines, S_list, N_list))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if a valid partition exists, the output is a valid set of indices; otherwise, it is '-1'.
